title: The Bride: God and His People as a Marriage
lead: The prophets picture God as Israel's husband and Zion as his bride (Isaiah 54:5; Isaiah 62:5; Hosea 2:19–20; Ezekiel 16:8), and Jews and Christians have read the Song of Songs as a picture of that love. In the New Testament Jesus is the bridegroom (Mark 2:19–20; John 3:29), the church is Christ's bride (2 Corinthians 11:2; Ephesians 5:25–32), and Revelation ends with the wedding of the Lamb and the holy city as his bride (Revelation 19:7; Revelation 21:2).
